title: CAPTA: Identifying LLMs Behind AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.32686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents access remote services through tools to complete user tasks, often via API calls. In this setting, a remote service may want to identify the backend LLM of an agent to launch model-specific attacks, including prompt injection or selective delivery of manipulated content. However, the service cannot directly query the backend model and must instead collect observable responses through its interactions with the agent, making identification challenging.   In this paper, we present Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart (CAPTA), a model identification approach inspired by CAPTCHA (Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart), which distinguishes humans from automated programs. translated_title: CAPTA：识别AI智能体背后的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过工具访问远程服务来完成用户任务，通常经由API调用实现。在这种场景下，远程服务可能希望识别智能体所使用的后端LLM，以便发起针对特定模型的攻击，包括提示注入或选择性地投递被篡改的内容。然而，该服务无法直接查询后端模型，只能通过与智能体交互收集可观察的响应，这使得识别变得具有挑战性。本文提出了CAPTA（Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart，区分LLM的完全自动化偏好测试），这是一种受CAPTCHA（区分计算机与人类的完全自动化公开图灵测试）启发的模型识别方法。CAPTA以选择题作为验证挑战的形式呈现，利用模型在选择偏好上的差异来识别后端LLM，并基于特定标准来选择问题。
tldr: 本文提出借鉴CAPTCHA思想的CAPTA方法，通过向AI智能体呈现选择题并分析不同模型的选择偏好差异，来识别智能体背后所使用的大语言模型。
